# Hospital

```{r}
hospital<-hospital[,c(1:12)]
hospital<-hospital[,-9]

```

```{r}
variables_interes <- hospital %>% 
  select(age, polimed, delta, charlson, quintil, sex)

# Statistical summary
summary(variables_interes)

# Age categorization
hospital$age_cat <- cut(hospital$age,
                     breaks = c(0, 40, 60, 75, 100),
                     labels = c("<40", "40-60", "60-75", ">75"))

#print(table(hospital$age_cat))
print(prop.table(table(hospital$age_cat)) * 100)
```
## Polymedication

```{r}
cat("Absolute frequencies:\n")
print(table(hospital$polimed))
cat("\nProportions:\n")
print(prop.table(table(hospital$polimed)) * 100)
```

## Events 
```{r}

print(prop.table(table(hospital$delta)) * 100)

# Create a more descriptive variable
hospital$event_type <- factor(hospital$delta,
                           levels = c(0, 1, 2),
                           labels = c("Censored", "Reinfection", "Death"))

print(table(hospital$event_type))

```

## Charlson index
```{r}

# Distribution by category
if(!"charlson_cat" %in% names(hospital)) {
  hospital$charlson_cat <- cut(hospital$charlson,
                            breaks = c(-1, 0, 2, 5, 20),
                            labels = c("0", "1-2", "3-5", ">5"))
}

#print(table(hospital$charlson_cat))
print(prop.table(table(hospital$charlson_cat)) * 100)
```

## Quintil, socioeconomic factor
```{r}

print(table(hospital$quintil))
print(prop.table(table(hospital$quintil)) * 100)

```

# Variables vs events
```{r}

# Age

print(tapply(hospital$age, hospital$event_type, summary))

# Polymedication

print(table(hospital$polimed, hospital$event_type))
print(prop.table(table(hospital$polimed, hospital$event_type), 1) * 100)

# Charlson index

print(tapply(hospital$charlson, hospital$event_type, summary))

# Quintil 

print(table(hospital$quintil, hospital$event_type))
print(prop.table(table(hospital$quintil, hospital$event_type), 1) * 100)
```

## Sex
```{r}

print(table(hospital$sex))
print(prop.table(table(hospital$sex)) * 100)
print(tapply(hospital$age, hospital$sex, summary))

print(table(hospital$sex, hospital$event_type))
print(prop.table(table(hospital$sex, hospital$event_type), 1) * 100)

# summary
tabla_resumen <- hospital %>%
  group_by(event_type) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    Age_mean = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    Age_sd = sd(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    Charlson_median = median(charlson, na.rm = TRUE),
    Charlson_IQR = IQR(charlson, na.rm = TRUE),
    Pct_Polymed = sum(polimed == "Si", na.rm = TRUE) / n() * 100,   # "Si" matches the original data factor level, kept as is
    Pct_Male = sum(sex == "Hombre", na.rm = TRUE) / n() * 100          # "Hombre" matches the original data factor level, kept as is
  )

print(tabla_resumen)
```

## graphs 
```{r}

# Age histogram
p1 <- ggplot(hospital, aes(x = age)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Age distribution", x = "Age (years)", y = "Frequancy") +
  theme_minimal()

# Charlson distribution
p2 <- ggplot(hospital, aes(x = charlson)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 15, fill = "coral", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Charlson Index Distribution", 
       x = "Charlson Index", y = "Frequency") +

library(patchwork)
fin <- p1 + p2

# Save
ggsave(
  "dists_hosp.png",
  plot = fin,
  width = 12,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)

# Events barplot
p3 <- ggplot(hospital, aes(x = event_type, fill = event_type)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(title = "Events distribution", x = "Types of events", y = "Frequency") +

# 6. Charlson categorized by event

  ggplot(aes(x = hsptime, y = age)) +

fin <- p6 + p8
```

# relationships

```{r data}
dat <- hospital %>%
  mutate(
    outcome = case_when(
      delta == 0 ~ "Censored",
      delta == 1 ~ "Reinfection",
      delta == 2 ~ "Death"
    ),
    outcome = factor(outcome, levels = c("Censored", "Reinfection", "Death"))
  )
```


```{r plot_overlap, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
p9<-dat %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = hsptime,
               names_to = "time_point", 
               values_to = "time") %>%    
  mutate(time_point = recode(time_point,
                             "hsptime" = "hospital time")) %>%  
  ggplot(aes(x = time, fill = outcome)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~time_point, ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Censored"    = "#6C757D",
               "Reinfection" = "#3A86FF",
               "Death"       = "#E63946")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of hospital time by Outcome",
    x     = "Time",
    y     = "Density",
    fill  = "Outcome (delta)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

ggsave(
  filename = "corr_hosp.png",
  plot = p9,
  width = 8,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 300
)
```

# Competing risk

```{r}
library(cmprsk)
# Basic cumulative incidence
ci_result <- with(hospital, cuminc(stime0, delta))

# View results in more detail (10 time points, 2 decimals)
print(ci_result, ntp = 10, digits = 2)

# Cumulative incidence analysis
with(hospital, cuminc(stime0, delta))

# Print in more detail
with(hospital, print(cuminc(stime0, delta), ntp = 10, digits = 2))

# Improved plot with customization
with(hospital, {
  ci <- cuminc(stime0, delta)
  ci2 <- ci[grep("1 1", names(ci))] # Survival curve

  plot(ci2, 
       ylim = c(0, 0.12),
       yaxt = "n",  
       xlab = "Days from day 120",
       ylab = "Cumulative Incidence",
       main = "CIF for reinfection ",
       col =  "red", 
       curvlab="reinfection of hospital",
       lwd = 2
  )
  
  axis(2, at = seq(0, 0.12, by = 0.01), las = 1)
  
  # Add grid for better readability
  grid(nx = NULL, ny = NULL, lty = 2, col = "gray90")
})
```
```{r}
library(cmprsk)
library(ggplot2)

with(hospital, {

  # Cumulative incidence
  ci <- cuminc(stime0, delta)

  # Event 1 = reinfection
  ci2 <- ci[["1 1"]]

  # Data frame for ggplot
  df <- data.frame(
    time = ci2$time,
    est  = ci2$est
  )

  # Plot
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = time, y = est)) +
    geom_step(
      color = "red",
      linewidth = 1,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 0.12),
      breaks = seq(0, 0.12, by = 0.01),
      labels = sprintf("%.2f", seq(0, 0.12, by = 0.01))
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, max(df$time) + 10),
      breaks = seq(0, 600, by = 100)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Days from day 120",
      y = "Cumulative Incidence"
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.major = element_line(
        linetype = "dashed",
        color = "gray80"
      ),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
    )

  # Show plot
  print(p)

  # Save at high resolution
  ggsave(
    filename = "hospital_reinfection_cif.png",
    plot = p,
    width = 8,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
  )

})
```

```{r,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}
library(cmprsk)

# ============================================================
# 1. STRATIFIED BY hospital PERIOD
# ============================================================

# Create cumulative incidence object OUTSIDE the with()
ci_period <- with(hospital, cuminc(stime0, delta, group = period))

# Now you can plot inside the with()
with(hospital, {
  ci_period_re <- ci_period[grep("1$", names(ci_period))]
  
  plot(ci_period_re, 
       ylim = c(0, 0.15),
       color = c(1, 2, 3),
       lty = c(1, 1, 1),
       curvlab=c("period1", "period2", "period3"),
       lwd = 3, 
       cex = 1.2,
       xlab = "Days from day 120",
       ylab = "Cumulative Incidence")
})
png("cumulative_incidence_period_hosp.png", width = 2400, height = 1800, res = 300)
# ============================================================
# 2. STRATIFIED BY CHARLSON INDEX
# ============================================================

hospital$charlson_cat <- cut(hospital$charlson,
                          breaks = c(-1, 0, 2, 5, 20),
                          labels = c("0", "1-2", "3-5", ">5"))

# CREATE OUTSIDE
ci_charlson <- with(hospital, cuminc(stime0, delta, group = charlson_cat))

# PLOT INSIDE
with(hospital, {
  ci_charlson_re <- ci_charlson[grep("1$", names(ci_charlson))]
  
  plot(ci_charlson_re,
       ylim = c(0, 0.2),
       color = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
       lty = c(1, 1, 1, 1),
       lwd = 3,
       cex = 1.2,
       curvlab=c("0","1-2","3-5",">5"),
       xlab = "Days from day 120",
       ylab = "Cumulative Incidence")
  
  title(main = "CIF for reinfection by Charlson Comorbidity Index")
})

# ============================================================
# 3. QUINTILE
# ============================================================

ci_quintil <- with(hospital, cuminc(stime0, delta, group = quintil))

with(hospital, {
  ci_quintil_re <- ci_quintil[grep("1$", names(ci_quintil))]
  
  plot(ci_quintil_re,
       ylim = c(0, 0.4),
       color = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
       lty = c(1, 1, 1, 1, 1),
       lwd = 3,
       cex = 1.2,
       curvlab=c("1","2","3","4","5"),
       xlab = "Days from day 120",
       ylab = "Cumulative Incidence")
  
  title(main = "CIF for reinfection by Socioeconomic Quintile")
})

# ============================================================
# 4. POLYMEDICATION
# ============================================================

ci_polimed <- with(hospital, cuminc(stime0, delta, group = polimed))

with(hospital, {
  ci_polimed_re <- ci_polimed[grep("1$", names(ci_polimed))]
  
  plot(ci_polimed_re,
       ylim = c(0, 0.5),
       color = c(1, 2),   
       lty = c(1, 1),
       lwd = 3,
       cex = 1.2,
       xlab = "Days from day 120",
       curvlab=c("Polymedication: No", "Polymadication: Yes"),
       ylab = "Cumulative Incidence")
  
  title(main = "CIF for reinfection by Polymedication Status")
})

# ============================================================
# 6. SEX
# ============================================================

ci_sex <- with(hospital, cuminc(stime0, delta, group = sex))

with(hospital, {
  cmpsex <- ci_sex[grep("1$", names(ci_sex))]
  
  par(las = 1, font = 2, font.lab = 2, font.axis = 2)
  plot(cmpsex,
       ylim = c(0, 0.17),
       color = c(1, 2),
       lty = c(1, 1),
       curvlab = c("Female: Reinfection", "Male: Reinfection"),
       lwd = 3,
       cex = 1.2,
       xlab = "Days from day 120",
       ylab = "Cumulative Incidence")
  
  title(main = "CIF for reinfection by Sex")
})

# ============================================================
# 8. SUMMARY
# ============================================================

cat("\n=== SUMMARY OF GRAY'S TESTS ===\n\n")

cat("PERIOD:\n")
print(ci_period$Tests)

cat("CHARLSON:\n")
print(ci_charlson$Tests)
cat("\n")
```

```{r}
library(broom)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(survival)

# Cox model for reinfection (event = 1)
causmod1 <- coxph(Surv(stime0, delta == 1) ~ sex + age + charlson + quintil+hsptime+polimed, 
                  data = hospital)

# Extract results
resultados <- tidy(causmod1, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = FALSE)

# Create custom table
tabla_cox <- data.frame(
  Variable = resultados$term,
  Beta = round(resultados$estimate, 3),
  SE = round(resultados$std.error, 3),
  CI_lower = round(resultados$conf.low, 3),
  CI_upper = round(resultados$conf.high, 3),
  Z_stat = round(resultados$statistic, 2),
  p_value = ifelse(resultados$p.value < 0.001, "<0.001", 
                   round(resultados$p.value, 3))
)

# Display table
kable(tabla_cox, 
      caption = "Cox Model for hospital-19 Reinfection",
      align = c('l', rep('c', 6)),
      col.names = c("Variable", "Est.", "SE", "CI Low", "CI Up", "Z", "p"),
      format = "latex",
      booktabs = TRUE) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position", "scale_down"),
                position = "center",
                font_size = 9,
                full_width = FALSE) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "2cm") %>%
  column_spec(2:7, width = "1.5cm") %>%
  footnote(general = paste("n =", causmod1$n, 
                          "; Events =", causmod1$nevent,
                          "; C-index =", round(summary(causmod1)$concordance[1], 2)),
           threeparttable = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(broom)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(survival)

# Cox model for reinfection (event = 1)
causmod1 <- coxph(Surv(stime0, delta == 1) ~ sex + age + charlson + quintil+polimed,
                  data = hospital)

# Extract results
resultados <- tidy(causmod1, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = FALSE)

# Create custom table
tabla_cox <- data.frame(
  Variable = resultados$term,
  Beta = round(resultados$estimate, 3),
  SE = round(resultados$std.error, 3),
  CI_lower = round(resultados$conf.low, 3),
  CI_upper = round(resultados$conf.high, 3),
  Z_stat = round(resultados$statistic, 2),
  p_value = ifelse(resultados$p.value < 0.001, "<0.001", 
                   round(resultados$p.value, 3))
)

# Display table
kable(tabla_cox, 
      caption = "Cox Model for hospital-19 Reinfection",
      align = c('l', rep('c', 6)),
      col.names = c("Variable", "Est.", "SE", "CI Low", "CI Up", "Z", "p"),
      format = "latex",
      booktabs = TRUE) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position", "scale_down"),
                position = "center",
                font_size = 9,
                full_width = FALSE) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "2cm") %>%
  column_spec(2:7, width = "1.5cm") %>%
  footnote(general = paste("n =", causmod1$n, 
                          "; Events =", causmod1$nevent,
                          "; C-index =", round(summary(causmod1)$concordance[1], 2)),
           threeparttable = TRUE)
```
